opening: Lord, meet us gently today and always
body: When I read Jesus’ words to go only to the lost sheep of Israel, I don’t hear exclusion—I hear the heart of a Shepherd. He first went to those who had known God but had wandered away, calling them back before sending His disciples to the whole world. It reminds me that God often begins His work close to home, seeking the hearts that have drifted before expanding His mission outward. His love was never meant for only a few; it has always been for everyone, one heart at a time.
